shape/shape.go.patch:
--- a/shape/shape.go
+++ b/shape/shape.go
@@ -2835,7 +2835,11 @@
 func (sh *shaping) printBlocked(res outcome) int {
 	sh.s.Puts("shape/protected_conflict: required edits touch protected files: " + strings.Join(res.paths, ", "))
 	sh.s.Puts(res.reason)
-	sh.s.Puts("Next: revise the request so it needs no edit to the files listed above, or review and commit those files outside Build, then shape again; preserve checks and actual check configuration. There is no protected-edit override.")
+	next := "Next: revise the request so it needs no edit to the files listed above, or review and commit those files outside Build, then shape again; preserve checks and actual check configuration. There is no protected-edit override."
+	if len(res.paths) == 1 && res.paths[0] == ".kogen/project.yaml" {
+		next = "Next: revise the request, or review and commit .kogen/project.yaml outside Build, then shape again; preserve checks and actual check configuration. There is no protected-edit override."
+	}
+	sh.s.Puts(next)
 	return 1
 }
